name: fleet-protocol
description: The control protocol between the `fleet` command (fleet-client) and the fleet host's control socket (fleet-core's fleet-control), with no dsh dependency. The session image's own protocols stay in fleet-image, which carries their other end

scripts.test: node -e "for (const path of ['lib', 'tsconfig.tsbuildinfo']) require('node:fs').rmSync(path, { recursive: true, force: true })" && tsc -b && node --test "lib/**/*.test.js"
